messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Je suis né sous Julio bien que tardivement, et je vécus à Rome sous le bon Auguste dans le temps des dieux faux et menteurs.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (French translation from Step 2)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|-------------------|--------| | Nacqui | the speaker’s birth event | né | was born | OK | | sub | “under” (temporal/political authority) | sous | under | OK | | Iulio | proper name of the ruler/era | Julio | Julio | OK | | ancor | concessive adverb “though” | bien | well/though (part of “bien que”) | OK | | che | subordinating conjunction introducing subjunctive clause | que | that | OK | | fosse | 3rd sg imperfect subjunctive of *essere* “to be” (state “it was”) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (French “bien que” does not require an explicit verb) | | tardi | adjective “late” (degree) | tardivement | late (adverbially) | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | et | and | OK | | vissi | the speaker’s habitation period | vécus | lived | OK | | a | preposition “at, in” (location) | à | at | OK | | Roma | proper name of the city | Rome | Rome | OK | | sotto | preposition “under” (political authority) | sous | under | OK | | ’l | definite article, masculine singular “the” | le | the | OK | | buono | adjective “good” (positive qualification) | bon | good | OK | | Augusto | proper name of the ruler | Auguste | Augustus | OK | | nel | contraction “in the” (temporal) | dans | in | OK | | tempo | noun “time” (epoch) | temps | time | OK | | de | preposition “of” linking epoch to gods | des* | of the (part of “des”) | OK | | li | definite article, masculine plural “the” (object of *de*) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (French “des” already fuses *de* + *les*) | | dèi | noun “gods” (divine beings) | dieux | gods | OK | | falsi | adjective “false” (attribute of gods) | faux | false | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | et | and | OK | | bugiardi | adjective “lying” (attribute of gods) | menteurs | lying | OK |
\*In French, **des** = *de* + *les*; therefore the source preposition **de** is rendered as **des**, while the plural article **li** is absorbed and not expressed separately.
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **fosse** – marked **UNNECESSARY**: French “bien que” conveys the concessive meaning without an explicit verb. - **li** – marked **UNNECESSARY**: the plural article is implicit in the French contraction **des**.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only French script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 70: - Original: Je suis né sous Julio bien que tardivement, - Issue: GRAMMAR (the concessive construction “bien que tardivement” is ungrammatical in French) - Corrected: Je suis né sous Julio, bien que tardif,
- Line 71: - Original: et je vécus à Rome sous le bon Auguste - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 72: - Original: dans le temps des dieux faux et menteurs. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
